professionalSummary: Program Manager with three years of experience leading API deprecation programmes at a platform company, delivering comprehensive deprecation plans, developer communication schedules, and closure reports in alignment with platform leadership directives.
experienceHighlights: Led five API deprecation programmes using the platform’s program method, each with a detailed deprecation plan and developer communication schedule.
Facilitated 32 monthly developer calls, addressing hostile questions and ensuring all open queries were answered in writing within five days.
Coordinated migration guides and tooling across API teams via a program tracker, recording readiness against each milestone.
Prepared shutdown readiness reviews, documenting responsibilities and confirming shutdown dates set by leadership.
Authored closure reports with program boundary statements and traffic evidence confirming deprecation completion, approved by the head of platform programs.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Deprecation plan and communication schedule for one programme; two developer call transcripts with follow‑up logs; shutdown readiness review with leadership date decision; closure report with traffic evidence – all archived as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s direct experience managing API deprecation programmes, handling developer communications, coordinating migration guides, preparing shutdown readiness, and producing closure reports. They do not provide evidence of the candidate’s ability to set shutdown dates (a leadership function) or of any independent decision‑making beyond the scope of the programmes.
